environment.description: Same Actix-web service deployed in the organization's 'restricted-web' OU. The OU has an SCP (scp-0a1b2c3d4e5f) that denies elasticloadbalancing:CreateListener and elasticloadbalancing:ModifyListener unless the action includes a reference to a WAF WebACL association. In practice, the deployment pipeline enforces ALB (not NLB) with an associated AWS WAF WebACL. However, the WebACL's rule configuration is managed by a separate security team via a CloudFormation StackSet and uses a custom rule group (not AWS managed rules). The custom rule group 'org-xss-reflection-detect' uses a regex pattern set that matches common reflected content patterns in response bodies via a response inspection configuration with status code 200 and content-type text/html. The IAM permission boundary (pb-web-service-boundary) attached to all roles in this OU denies wafv2:DeleteWebACL, wafv2:UpdateWebACL, and wafv2:DisassociateWebACL, preventing service teams from removing or modifying the WAF protection. The permission boundary also denies ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress for port ranges that would bypass the ALB.

config.load_balancer: ALB with mandatory WAF WebACL association
config.scp_effect: Deny listener creation/modification without WAF WebACL

response_inspection.body_inspection: regex pattern set matching reflected XSS patterns
